rule: Loopback-first secure bind — mobo HDA preferred over USB card over HDMI
remediation: Verify /dev/snd exists — load snd_hda_intel or snd_usb_audio if missing
Ensure user is in the audio group: sudo usermod -aG audio $USER
PipeWire on auto_null means no hardware sink — install firmware/driver for onboard codec
BIOS: onboard HD Audio must be enabled; disable conflicting virtual audio if needed
After driver load: pactl list sinks short — expect alsa_output.* not auto_null
